# NoorSoul — AI Islamic Spiritual Wellness App

> NoorSoul (نور) is an AI-powered Islamic spiritual wellness mobile application for iOS and Android, rooted in 1,400+ years of classical Islamic scholarship. Built strictly for Tafakkur (contemplation), Quranic remembrance, and daily devotional discipline — never divination or magic.

## Primary Pages

- [Home & App Download](https://noor-app.com/): Main landing page featuring the interactive live Abjad preview, 9 core spiritual modules, 12 life dimensions, pricing plans, FAQ, and iOS/Android download links.
- [About NoorSoul](https://noor-app.com/about.html): Philosophy, classical Islamic manuscript foundations, founder mission, and ethical boundaries.
- [Contact & Support](https://noor-app.com/contact.html): Customer support, Murshid Connect practitioner verification applications, and institutional/mosque licensing enquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](https://noor-app.com/privacy-policy.html): Data collection, Firebase security, Alim AI processing, RevenueCat billing, and account deletion rights.
- [Terms of Service](https://noor-app.com/terms-of-service.html): User licence, NoorSoul+ auto-renewal terms, Murshid Connect terms, and intellectual property.
- [Spiritual & Medical Disclaimer](https://noor-app.com/disclaimer.html): Tafakkur (not divination, not magic) and non-medical / non-fatwa scope.
- [Cookie Policy](https://noor-app.com/cookie-policy.html): Minimal browser storage with zero third-party advertising trackers.

## Core Mobile App Modules

- **Abjad Profile Engine (`Hisab al-Jummal`)**: Calculates a user's Abjad total, dominant Arabic letter, classical element (Fire, Water, Air, Earth), aligned Divine Name from the 99 *Asma ul-Husna*, reduced archetype (1–9), Wafq constant, and lucky days from an Arabic or English name.
- **Daily Wazifa & Amaliyat**: Generates personalised daily *wird* mapped to the five prayer times (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) and Hijri calendar occasions (Ramadan, Ashura, Mawlid), plus a 30-day Wazifa Tracker.
- **Islamic Crystal Guide (`Ilm al-Jawahir`)**: Library of 40 therapeutic crystals and gemstones cited from Ibn Sina's *Al-Qanun fi al-Tibb* and Al-Biruni's *Kitab al-Jamahir*, matched by element and life dimension.
- **Nuqush Studio (`Ilm al-Wafq`)**: Generates personalised 3×3 mathematical *Wafq* squares and Islamic geometric artwork exportable at high resolution.
- **Muraqaba**: Guided Islamic contemplative practice (*Ihsan*) across 4 session stages (*Sukun*, *Niyyah*, *Muraqaba*, *Munajat*) and 4 depth levels (*Hudur*, *Tawajjuh*, *Fana*, *Istighraq*).
- **Ruqyah**: Authenticated Quranic verses (Al-Fatiha, Ayat al-Kursi, Al-Falaq, An-Nas, Al-Baqarah 285–286) and Prophetic healing du'as from Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim with guided timers.
- **Compatibility Engine**: Calculates elemental and numeric harmony between two names across Romantic, Friendly, Career, City, Organisation, and Brotherly modes.
- **Alim AI**: Scholar-grounded AI assistant personalised to the user's Abjad profile.
- **Murshid Connect**: Element-matched 1-on-1 directory of verified Sufi Murshids, Ruqyah practitioners, Islamic life coaches, female Murshidas, and Abjad readers.

## Classical Scholarly Sources

- Al-Buni — *Shams al-Maarif al-Kubra* (13th century)
- Ibn Arabi — *Al-Futuhat al-Makkiyya* (13th century)
- Ibn Sina — *Al-Qanun fi al-Tibb* (11th century)
- Al-Biruni — *Kitab al-Jamahir* (11th century)
- Imam Al-Ghazali — *Ihya Ulum al-Din* (11th century)
- Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyyah — *Al-Wabil al-Sayyib* (14th century)
- *Sahih al-Bukhari* & *Sahih Muslim* (9th century)

## Plans & Platforms

- **Platforms**: Apple App Store (iOS 16+) and Google Play (Android 12+), English & Arabic RTL support.
- **Free Forever (£0)**: Core Abjad profile, 3 daily Amaliyat, 20 crystals, basic Wazifa tracker, Muraqaba & Ruqyah timers.
- **NoorSoul+ Monthly (£7.99/month)** & **NoorSoul+ Annual (£59.99/year)**: Unlimited Amaliyat, full 40-crystal database, Nuqush Studio, unlimited Alim AI, AR Crystal Scanner.
- **Institutional Plans**: Volume licensing for mosques, Islamic schools, and employers.

## Ethical Boundaries

- *Tafakkur · Not divination · Not magic.*
- “NoorSoul is a tool for tafakkur — deep Islamic reflection. It is not divination, not magic, and not a substitute for scholarly guidance.”
- Does not claim to predict the unseen (*Ilm al-Ghayb*) or replace medical/clinical care.
